text: 1.Certificat de santé Photocopie de l_foreignier examination record notarié (for durations of study over 6 months) 2.Photocopie du passeport valide With name.passport number&expiration date ,and photo included 3.Photo de passeport A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.Relevé de notes de l'école postgraduate 5.Diplôme de master Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 6.Une lettre de recommandation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7.Déclaration de soutien financier Photocopy of the financial support statement with signature 8.Certificat de HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test ) for non-English courses
